blind_target.evidence_quote: Furthermore, in light of Olivers and Nieuwenhuis’ (2005, 2006) overinvestment hypothesis I expected that any type of distraction diminishes the AB effect, as it would diminish the over focusing of attentional resources on T1 processing.
blind_target.outcome_quote: However, I found no effects of distraction, nor did I find any effects of mood, nor an interaction between distraction and mood. blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The fourth stated aim tests the previously reported reduction in attentional blink with distraction. No distraction effect was found. Included as a conceptual retest of the finding rather than merely theoretical background.
blind_target.title: The beneficial effect of concurrent task-irrelevant mental activity on temporal attention
